meta: AI chatbots answer as smoothly as a real person. But do they "understand" you? What they really do is a lot like your phone keyboard suggesting words: guessing the next word.

muc.title: Does AI "understand" you?
muc.text: AI answers as smoothly as a real person. But inside, it's doing something surprisingly simple.

muc.title: Like your keyboard's word suggestions
muc.text: You've seen your phone keyboard suggest the next word. Type "happy", and it guesses "birthday" right away.

muc.title: A chatbot is a giant suggestion keyboard
muc.text: An AI chatbot also guesses the next word. It's just been trained on a huge amount of text, more than one person could read in a thousand lifetimes.

muc.title: One word at a time
muc.text: When you ask something, it picks the best-fitting word, adds it, then guesses the next one, again and again until the answer is done.

muc.title: How can guessing words be so good?
muc.text: To guess well, it has to learn grammar, facts and even how to reason. That's why its answers sound so good.

muc.title: What to remember
muc.text: But remember: it guesses what sounds most likely, and that's not always the truth.

muc.title: Explain step by step
muc.text: For hard questions, add "explain step by step". Writing out each step helps AI guess more accurately, and makes it easier for you to check.
